{{- /* Twikoo — full upstream-equivalent loader */ -}} {{- $t := .Site.Params.twikoo | default dict -}} {{- if not ($t.envId | default "") }}{{/* credentials required */}}{{ else }} {{- $c := .Site.Params.comments | default dict -}} {{- $lazyload := $c.lazyload | default false -}} {{- $count := $c.count | default false -}} {{- $option := $t.option | default dict -}} {{- $use := $c.use | default slice -}} {{- if reflect.IsSlice $use | not }}{{ if $use }}{{ $use = slice $use }}{{ else }}{{ $use = slice }}{{ end }}{{ end -}} {{- $norm := slice -}} {{- range $use }}{{ $norm = $norm | append (. | title) }}{{ end -}} {{- $first := "" }}{{ if gt (len $norm) 0 }}{{ $first = index $norm 0 }}{{ end -}} {{- $js := $t.js | default "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/twikoo@1.6.44/dist/twikoo.all.min.js" -}} {{- end }}
